propositions: Comment triage alone cannot reduce size-pressured files event_append.py (791/800) and _processors.py (777/800) because their comments encode replay-compatibility justifications that are load-bearing invariants.

Multiple verified-stale comments exist across scope that document obsolete referents or outdated paths (gitutil.py module-import claim, hlc.py release-duration claim, filters.py bash-duality justification, llm_format.py header path and key-map enumeration).
The wire-format changelog is duplicated across reducer/_version.py and docs/event-schema.md with the docs copy being partial and stale (missing v4/v5 entries).

SNAPSHOT-restore migration guards in reducer/_processors.py:719-774 have load-bearing rationale that must not be relocated, as one guard explicitly warns its condition must not run unconditionally to avoid clobbering a channel state.

The highest-risk comment relocations (event_append recover helpers ~140 lines, _processors snapshot migration blocks ~80 lines) are out of scope and require structural refactoring rather than comment cleanup.
